The exact official Building Department SIGN FEES.pdf URL was also rechecked and remains the same 28092-byte SHA-256-identical file as the archived sign guide; treat that as source-file identity evidence only and do not let the older guide override or broaden the current Commercial Building Permit Fees page. Preserve the archived Building Department sign guide as historical instructions unless newer official evidence independently confirms a specific statement inside it.
